scope: Preserve retained Kashyyyk, NPE, Nova Orion, township, heroic, quest, item, and instance transition content while preventing the removed NGE player combat level from becoming authoritative in current or future zone admission rows and proving every production transition consumer remains bounded by the shared permission or retained Rryatt callback paths.

findings: Publish 14.1 characters progress through learned skill boxes and a 250-point skill budget rather than an NGE profession template or visible combat level.
The retained expansion transition library supports authored quest, task, item, object-variable, script-variable, and compatibility level gates for later zones and instances.
The established retained-content adapter maps learned PRE-CU combat skill boxes to the hidden 1-90 compatibility scale without exposing an NGE player level.
Current transition data has no active level gate, so this correction preserves every present destination and admission result while closing latent NGE precedence for future retained rows.
The complete production API inventory contains eleven transition-library calls in five consumer files; all eight admission calls enter or explicitly re-enter the shared permission function.
zonePlayerNoGate is a historical name rather than a permission bypass: it checks initialRequiredFlag before resolving or executing its destination.

The only two direct low-level world-transition calls are inside the retained Rryatt movement callback; all nine message producers are authenticated Rryatt quest, guide, and unsticking scripts, while zoneIn=false traversal returns to transition.zonePlayer.
